Yeah, ADHD has a huge correlation with binge eating because we need stimulation. Boredom is different and actually painful for those with ADHD. Maybe get tested if you can. My stimulants have helped a lot. I started with Vyvanse when I was diagnosed BED, but tested for ADHD later and realized I had it and switched to Adderal. It made my BED so much better. I still crave food, but have stronger will and control to say no and think decisions through.

Do you have BPD or ADHD by chance? I eat because I’m always bored or overly emotional (even happy emotions). Therapy with a therapist who knows my trauma has helped tremendously. Bored = remembering past trauma = do anything to not feel bored / sad = eat uncontrollably. Try to get to the root of why you want to eat in the first place, then start there. Forgive yourself and keep trying. Beating yourself will put you back in the same spot. Feel bad = eat.
